properties.description: Occupancy equals an independent depth-16 queue count at every eligible pre/post sample. Acceptance depends only on expected pre-edge occupancy: writes at full and reads at empty are rejected, including simultaneous requests.
Full is asserted exactly when the independent expected queue contains sixteen words; unknown status is an alarm.
Empty is asserted exactly when the independent expected queue contains zero words; unknown status is an alarm.

Whenever the expected queue is nonempty, asynchronous front data equals its oldest accepted word. Checks ordering, simultaneous transfers, wraparound and post-reset operation without constraining empty data.
After a synchronous reset edge and until the next edge, occupancy is zero, full is low and empty is high, including resets that discard queued words.
Public occupancy is in the range zero through sixteen, and public full and empty agree with that occupancy. Unknown occupancy or status produces an alarm.
